A session opened on /Users/aslan_nejad/Desktop/DEV/smg/visitor-analytics/VisitorAnalytics1.0 does NOT talk to this server. ~/.claude.json has a project-scoped mcpServers override for that path pointing `memory` at a stdio process from a different repo — github.com/serkansmg/smg-claude-memory-mcp, checked out at ~/Desktop/DEV/smg/smg-claude-memory-mcp — with MEMORY_MCP_DATA_DIR=~/.memory-mcp. That fork is at v0.5.0 and contains zero asoode code and no task module, so a session there sees no asoode tools and no bound-board brief, no matter what ships here.

Every other project resolves `memory` from the top-level ~/.claude.json entry: http://127.0.0.1:8765/mcp, the launchd daemon (com.claude-memory-mcp.daemon) running ~/.claude-memory-mcp/runtime, v0.6.0, data dir ~/.claude-memory-mcp.

The two registries are separate stores. ~/.memory-mcp/registry.duckdb knows only va1-panel and visitoranalytics10, and points the latter at VisitorAnalytics1.0/.memory-mcp.duckdb (in-repo, 271 memories). The daemon's registry has its own visitoranalytics10.duckdb with 0 memories. So dropping the override without migrating that file would hand the project an empty memory.

Consequence for diagnosis: when a session reports that asoode/tasks are missing, check which server it is actually bound to before suspecting this code. Commit 7e8ee77 ("Teach every session what asoode is") cannot reach a session on the fork — the fix ships in this server's SERVER_INSTRUCTIONS, which that session never loads.
title: One machine, two memory servers: the SMG fork shadows this one for VisitorAnalytics1.0

content:
Three Opus agents audited both codebases on 2026-09-03 and the findings are written down so neither repo needs re-reading.

In claude-memory-mcp:
- docs/bridge/README.md — index + the short version
- docs/bridge/01-asoode-analysis.md — asoode: the 20 existing MCP tools, Prisma data model (Group>Project>WorkPackage>WorkPackageList>WorkPackageTask, all uuid PKs), every task endpoint, the RabbitMQ->Socket.IO event pipeline with payloads, PAT auth, ports, verified gap list
- docs/bridge/02-memory-mcp-analysis.md — this repo: layering, DuckDB+SQLite schemas, migration contract, project identity, the pending/adaptation subsystem, all three sync mechanisms, the remote gateway, daemon/UI, extension seams
- docs/bridge/03-claude-ui-surfaces.md — Browser pane + .claude/launch.json is how you show asoode inside Claude; plugins have NO UI extension point; MCP Apps/ui:// unsupported in Claude Code
- docs/bridge/04-design-decisions.md — the agreed design

In asoode (/Users/aslan_nejad/Desktop/DEV/achasoft/asoode):
- docs/claude-bridge-backlog.md — prioritised asoode changes with file:line change sites (P0 blockers through P3 MCP tool coverage)
- docs/claude-bridge-prompt.md — the session-opening prompt for the asoode work

Line numbers are from 2026-09-03 working trees. Where a doc and the code disagree, the code wins — correct the doc.
